info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access and retrieve the status of credit card applications alongside their credit check results. It is designed for financial institutions and service providers that need to monitor application progress and ensure compliance with credit assessment requirements. Typical use cases include evaluating customer requests, managing application workflows, and performing risk analysis. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can streamline their decision-making processes based on real-time credit check data.

get.summary: Retrieve credit check details for an application.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed credit check information related to a specific application. You can use it to assess the creditworthiness of an applicant based on their submitted data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a credit check for an application. It requires specific parameters defined in the schema to process the request successfully.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: This schema represents the request body expected for the Credit Check operation. It is provided as a string format.

status.description: Indicates whether the credit check operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the credit check request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the credit check.

state.description: Current state of the credit check operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the credit check request in milliseconds.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the credit check operation.
